_comment: Acquisition settings for fetch_county_features.py. Each source writes one
fips-keyed CSV under data/features/, registered for the adaptive feature
search in configs/feature_plugins.json. A source that fails (network,
schema drift, missing secret) writes nothing and is recorded in
county_features.py skips a missing file, so a failed source never breaks
the county step. URLs are lists: the first that answers is used.
Zoning regime has no national county-level source. The National Zoning
Atlas covers a minority of jurisdictions, unevenly by state, and would
enter the search as a detection-biased variable. It is not built.

water_use.license: public domain (USGS Estimated Use of Water in the United States, county data 2015)
